reason: The proposed coefficient-normalization inference is not licensed by lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone. That lemma requires 0 <= delta, but lem-maincb-error-improvement supplies only a finite coefficient c_old < infinity. In the case that actually needs enlargement, c_old < 0 and epsilon > 0 give delta = c_old*epsilon < 0, so the cited monotonicity lemma cannot be applied to pass from an extended c_old*epsilon-inclusion to an extended max(c_old,0)*epsilon-inclusion. The node must either derive c_old >= 0 from allowed inputs or directly prove negative-to-zero tolerance monotonicity from def-extended-delta-inclusion; neither argument is present.
